title: Noetherianity and local regularity of strict hensel divisor quotient
statement: The strict henselization divisor quotient is Noetherian and all its prime localizations are regular local.

proof.text: Use the canonical small-to-full affine-colimit ring isomorphism e. Its coprojection formula identifies Spec(e.hom) followed by the small structural map with strictLocalizationToBase. Transport b along e.hom; an inverse map proves that its image of f is still a nonunit. Apply the retained upstream divisor-quotient presentation. The inverse ring equivalence sends the principal ideal generated by (b followed by e.hom)(f) to the ideal generated by b(f), so Ideal.quotientEquiv gives the quotient ring isomorphism. Pull the supplied local-base algebra action back through this isomorphism, and compose the pointed-etale universal cocone isomorphism with the resulting algebra isomorphism. This gives the same algebraic strict henselization property on the original small-colimit divisor quotient, without using regularity.

Since R/(f) is regular, Mathlib gives regular locality and Noetherianity of its prime localization A. Apply Algebra.isRegularLocalRing_iff_strictHenselization to this A, K, and the actual divisor quotient to obtain its regular locality.

A regular local ring is Noetherian by its class fields. For each prime q of the quotient apply IsRegularLocalRing.localization_at_prime_and_isRegularRing to obtain its regular prime localization. Combine these two clauses.

lean.statement:
theorem strictHenselizationRing_divisor_quotient_noetherian_and_local_regular
    (R : CommRingCat.{u}) [IsRegularRing R] (f : R)
    [IsRegularRing (R ⧸ Ideal.span {f})]
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (barY : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Spec R)
    (b : R ⟶ strictHenselizationRing barY)
    (hb : Spec.map b = strictHenselizationStructuralMap barY)
    (hg : ¬ IsUnit (b.hom f)) :
    IsNoetherianRing (strictHenselizationRing barY ⧸ Ideal.span {b.hom f}) ∧
      ∀ (p : Ideal (strictHenselizationRing barY ⧸ Ideal.span {b.hom f}))
        [p.IsPrime],
        IsRegularLocalRing (Localization.AtPrime p)
